summary: Frontend-only SPA routing verification for the /admin route after adding frontend/public/_redirects. Tested via Playwright on the preview URL: (1) fresh direct page.goto to <base>/admin returned HTTP 200 and rendered the Admin login screen (admin-login-screen / admin-password-input / admin-login-submit visible), (2) full page.reload on /admin returned 200 and kept the Admin login screen with URL unchanged, (3) login with the provided admin password succeeded and the admin dashboard rendered (product-add-button visible), (4) home route '/' still loads correctly (title 'Meè & U — Perfume & Attar', content rendered). No console errors (only React DevTools info + a benign scroll-container warning). No error elements found on page.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/public/_redirects contains the correct single rule '/*    /index.html   200' and lives in public/, so CRA will copy it to build/ — Netlify will pick it up only after the user redeploys. Verified in-app routing on the Emergent preview (which already rewrites unknown paths to index.html), so this is the closest available validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA routing for /admin verified working on preview (direct load + reload + admin login). Admin page test ids: admin-login-screen, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, product-add-button. Netlify _redirects effect can only be confirmed post-deploy by the user.
rca_of_the_issue: Original 404 was a static-host issue: Netlify had no rewrite rule, so a direct request to /admin looked for a non-existent file. Adding public/_redirects with '/*  /index.html  200' makes the host serve index.html for all paths so React Router handles the route client-side.
